Rules.Title: 禁止靜默吞掉異常或以虛擬變數/註解規避檢查

Decision.Instructions: Does this code silently swallow exceptions (e.g., empty catch/except block, bare `pass`, returning fake success), or use dummy assignments/suppression comments (like `_ = e`, `# noqa`) purely to bypass linting without genuine error handling? Ignore intentional, documented fallback logic or explicit cancellation handling.

Rules.Title: 實作完整性與表裡一致性檢查 (抓假實作/空殼)

Decision.Instructions: Classify the implementation integrity of this function or component relative to its name, signature, and comments.

Criteria.real_impl: Genuine, complete implementation matching its name and contract (including short helper/adapter/property methods).
Criteria.stub_or_mock: Fake placeholder, TODO/NotImplemented, hardcoded dummy return pretending to execute real work.
Criteria.misleading: Implementation performs destructive or contradictory behavior relative to its name or docstring.

Rules.Title: 網路請求須妥善處理逾時、取消或非成功狀態碼

Decision.Instructions: Does this function initiate an external network/HTTP/socket request without any timeout/cancellation mechanism AND without checking or propagating failure responses/exceptions? Ignore helper wrappers that accept timeout/client configuration as parameters or delegate timeout to an injected client.

Rules.Title: 檔案/串流 I/O 須確保資源釋放與文字編碼安全

Decision.Instructions: Does this function open a file, stream, or database handle without deterministic cleanup (`with`, `using`, `try/finally`, `defer`), OR read/write text files relying on platform default encoding instead of explicit UTF-8 where cross-platform portability matters? Ignore binary mode (`rb`/`wb`) and factory functions intentionally returning an open stream.

Rules.Title: 非同步與併發路徑防呆 (阻塞或遺失例外)

Decision.Instructions: Does this concurrent/async function introduce a clear concurrency bug such as synchronous blocking (`time.sleep`, `Thread.Sleep`, `.Result`, `.Wait()`) inside an async flow, fire-and-forget background task that drops unhandled exceptions, or mutating shared state across threads without synchronization?

Rules.Title: UI 事件處理器不可同步阻塞主執行緒

Decision.Instructions: Does this UI event handler or command synchronously block the UI thread with heavy disk I/O, network calls, `time.sleep`/`Thread.Sleep`, or `.Result`/`.Wait()` instead of using async/await or background dispatch?

Rules.Title: 禁止命令注入、動態執行未驗證輸入或硬編碼密鑰

Decision.Instructions: Does this code contain an actual security vulnerability such as command injection (`shell=True` with dynamic input), `eval`/`exec` on untrusted strings, SQL string interpolation with variables, or hardcoded production API keys/passwords? Ignore test fixtures, placeholder strings, or parameterized queries.
